text: Classic pancakes (serves 4). 200 g plain flour, 2 eggs, 300 ml milk, a pinch of salt and butter for the pan. Whisk, let the batter rest 15 minutes, then cook the pancakes for about 15 minutes.
Hummus. Blend 400 g cooked chickpeas, 3 tbsp tahini, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, 3 tbsp olive oil and a little water until smooth. 10 minutes. Serves 6.

Chicken stir-fry for 2. Slice 300 g chicken breast and fry it for 8 minutes with peppers and onion. Add 3 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp honey and cook 4 more minutes. Serve with rice. Ready in 30 minutes.

Caesar salad (serves 2, 20 minutes). Romaine lettuce, a handful of croutons and 40 g parmesan. For the dressing whisk 1 egg yolk, 2 anchovy fillets, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, lemon juice, olive oil and a dash of Worcestershire sauce.
Pesto pasta for 4. Cook 400 g spaghetti. Blend a big bunch of basil, 50 g pine nuts, 50 g parmesan, 1 garlic clove and olive oil, and toss with the pasta. Ready in 15 minutes.
Vegan chocolate cake, 8 slices. Mix 250 g flour, 200 g sugar, 40 g cocoa, 1 tsp baking soda, 300 ml oat milk, 80 ml sunflower oil and 1 tbsp vinegar (15 minutes). Bake 35 minutes at 180°C.
Moules marinières (pour 4). 2 kg de moules, 2 échalotes, 20 cl de vin blanc, 30 g de beurre et du persil. Préparation 15 min, cuisson 10 min.
Peanut butter cookies, makes 20. Mix 250 g peanut butter, 200 g sugar and 1 egg (10 minutes), shape into balls and bake for 12 minutes.
Tofu and vegetable curry (4 servings, 35 minutes). Fry 400 g firm tofu, add 2 tbsp Thai red curry paste (the jar lists shrimp paste), 400 ml coconut milk and spinach. Serve with rice.

Gazpacho (6 raciones). 1 kg de tomates maduros, 1 pimiento verde, 1 pepino, 1 diente de ajo, 50 g de pan del día anterior, 100 ml de aceite de oliva, 2 cucharadas de vinagre de Jerez y sal. Triturar todo (15 minutos) y enfriar 2 horas en la nevera.
Shrimp scampi for 2, 20 minutes. Cook 200 g linguine. Fry 3 garlic cloves in 40 g butter, add 300 g shrimp and 100 ml white wine, then the pasta and parsley.
Overnight oats, 1 serving. Mix 50 g rolled oats, 150 ml almond milk and 1 tbsp chia seeds (5 minutes) and leave in the fridge for 8 hours. Top with berries.
Beef burgers, makes 4. Mix 600 g minced beef, 1 egg, 40 g breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Grill and serve in brioche buns with cheddar, mustard and mayonnaise. 30 minutes.
Miso soup for 2 in 10 minutes. Heat 600 ml dashi, dissolve 2 tbsp white miso, add 100 g silken tofu, wakame and spring onion.
Guacamole (serves 4, 10 minutes). Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, half a red onion, 1 tomato, coriander, salt and a little chili.

Risotto ai funghi (4 persone). 320 g di riso Carnaroli, 300 g di funghi, 1 cipolla, 1 litro di brodo vegetale (sedano, carota, cipolla), 100 ml di vino bianco, 50 g di burro e 60 g di parmigiano. 40 minuti.

Satay chicken skewers, 4 servings. Cut 500 g chicken thighs (15 minutes) and marinate for 1 hour. Grill for 12 minutes. For the sauce mix 4 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, lime and coconut milk.

Falafel, makes 16 (serves 4). Soak 250 g dried chickpeas overnight (12 hours). Blend with onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and 2 tbsp flour (20 minutes), shape and fry for 10 minutes. Serve with tahini sauce.
Greek salad for 2 (10 minutes). Tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olives, 150 g feta, oregano and olive oil.
Spaghetti carbonara (2 people, 20 minutes). 200 g spaghetti, 100 g guanciale, 2 egg yolks and 1 whole egg, 50 g pecorino and plenty of black pepper.
Banana bread, 10 slices. Mash 3 ripe bananas and mix with 75 g melted butter, 150 g sugar, 1 egg, 190 g flour, 1 tsp baking soda and 50 g chopped walnuts. Prep 15 minutes, bake 60 minutes.
Red lentil soup (6 servings). Cook 300 g red lentils with 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery stalks and 1.5 l water, season with cumin and finish with lemon. 40 minutes.
Ceviche for 4. Dice 500 g very fresh sea bass (15 minutes) and marinate it for 20 minutes in the juice of 6 limes with red onion, chili and coriander. Serve with sweet potato.
Rösti (für 2 Personen). 600 g gekochte Kartoffeln vom Vortag reiben, salzen und in 30 g Butter goldbraun braten. Zubereitung 10 Minuten, Bratzeit 20 Minuten.

Fondue moitié-moitié (4 personnes). 400 g de gruyère, 400 g de vacherin fribourgeois, 3 dl de vin blanc, 1 gousse d'ail, 1 c. à soupe de fécule de maïs, 4 cl de kirsch et du pain en cubes. 25 minutes.
Pad thai for 2 (25 minutes). 150 g rice noodles, 150 g prawns, 1 egg, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp tamarind paste, bean sprouts, 30 g crushed peanuts and lime.
Homemade mayonnaise, makes about 250 ml in 5 minutes. Whisk 1 egg yolk with 1 tsp mustard, then add 200 ml sunflower oil slowly, lemon juice and salt.
Vegan Buddha bowl (1 bowl, 30 minutes). Quinoa, roasted chickpeas, 100 g tempeh, avocado and kale, with a dressing of 2 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp tamari and maple syrup.

Fish and chips (4 servings, 45 minutes). 4 cod fillets in a batter of 200 g flour and 300 ml cold beer, fried potatoes, and tartare sauce made with homemade mayonnaise (egg yolk and oil), capers and gherkins.
Apple crumble (6 servings). Slice 6 apples. Rub 100 g flour, 75 g oats and 100 g cold butter with 80 g brown sugar and cinnamon. Prep 20 minutes, bake 35 minutes.
Paella de marisco (6 raciones). 400 g de arroz bomba, 300 g de gambas, 500 g de mejillones, 200 g de calamar, 1 pimiento rojo, tomate, azafrán y 1,2 l de caldo de pescado. 60 minutos.
Granola (12 servings). Mix 300 g oats, 100 g almonds, 50 g pumpkin seeds, 80 ml maple syrup and 60 ml coconut oil (10 minutes) and bake for 25 minutes at 160°C.

Chili sin carne (4 servings, 50 minutes). 2 cans of kidney beans, 1 can of black beans, onion, peppers, tomatoes, cumin, chili and 2 squares of 85% dark chocolate (ingredients: cocoa mass, cocoa butter, sugar).
Eggs Benedict for 2 (25 minutes). 2 English muffins, 4 poached eggs, 4 slices of ham and a hollandaise made with 2 egg yolks, 100 g butter and lemon.
Waldorf salad (4 servings, 15 minutes). 2 apples, 3 celery stalks, 60 g walnuts and grapes, dressed with 4 tbsp mayonnaise (egg, oil and mustard) and lemon.
Tiramisù (6 porzioni). 300 g di savoiardi, 500 g di mascarpone, 4 uova, 100 g di zucchero, caffè e cacao. Preparazione 30 minuti, riposo in frigo 4 ore.
Tabbouleh (4 servings). Soak 100 g bulgur for 15 minutes, then mix with lots of parsley and mint, tomatoes, cucumber, lemon and olive oil (20 minutes).
Salmon teriyaki for 2 (20 minutes). 2 salmon fillets glazed with 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin and 1 tbsp sugar, sprinkled with sesame seeds, with steamed rice.
Lupin hummus (4 servings, 10 minutes). Blend 250 g cooked lupin beans, 2 tbsp tahini, garlic, lemon and olive oil.
Bircher Müesli (2 Portionen). 80 g Haferflocken, 200 ml Milch, 1 Joghurt, 1 geriebener Apfel, 20 g Haselnüsse und Honig mischen (10 Minuten) und über Nacht 8 Stunden einweichen.
Vegan mushroom stroganoff (4 servings, 30 minutes). 500 g mushrooms, onion and garlic cooked with 200 ml oat cream, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard and smoked paprika, served with pasta.

Green papaya salad (2 servings, 15 minutes). Shredded green papaya, cherry tomatoes and green beans, dressed with 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp dried shrimp, lime and palm sugar, topped with 2 tbsp roasted peanuts.
Quiche lorraine (6 servings). Shortcrust pastry with 200 g flour and 100 g butter, filled with 200 g bacon, 3 eggs, 200 ml cream and 100 g gruyère. Prep 25 minutes, bake 35 minutes.
Ratatouille (6 servings, 1 hour). Aubergine, courgettes, peppers, onion, tomatoes and garlic, slowly cooked in olive oil with herbes de Provence.
Pulpo a la gallega (4 raciones). 1 pulpo de 2 kg, patatas, pimentón, sal gorda y aceite de oliva. Cocer 50 minutos y dejar reposar 20.
Couscous salad (4 servings, 20 minutes). 200 g couscous, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, crumbled feta, mint and a lemon dressing.
Honey-glazed carrots (4 servings, 25 minutes). 600 g carrots roasted with 2 tbsp honey, 20 g butter and thyme.

Rainbow spring rolls, 8 rolls (serves 4, 30 minutes). Rice paper, vermicelli, carrots, cucumber, mint and 150 g cooked prawns, with a dipping sauce of 2 tbsp hoisin sauce (soybeans, sugar, wheat flour) and crushed peanuts.
